feed.headline: Six deals that shaped the week.

items.sub: US-led consortium agrees to buy 42% of the club
The NBA's preferred prediction market exchanges
10-year naming rights deal, now Ariat Arena
Official partner of the BBL and WBBL, plus five clubs
Official apparel partner, new jersey debuts in Las Vegas

caption:
Six deals that shaped the week.

A US-led consortium agreed to buy 42% of Valencia, the NBA named Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction market exchanges, and Ariat took a 10-year naming rights deal on Fort Worth's Dickies Arena. Closer to home, Youi joined the Big Bash and adidas put the Melbourne Storm in three stripes.

Today's lead: OXEN becomes the Dolphins' on-field apparel partner from 2027, stepping up from the Academy and boots to the main jersey. The new ECHO home jersey was unveiled alongside.

Also today: Pepperstone x Fernando Alonso, Mountain Culture x Melbourne Stars, Queensland Country Bank x Brisbane Heat, Omega x Sydney Thunder, Tourism WA x Richmond / Essendon.
